text:
mikaela: quick pulse — noticed a ~12% drop in webinar->signup on the new q3 landing. dashboard spike at 13:05 UTC. anyone changed attribution windows or filters?

sam: saw that too. looks like a cohort shift for traffic source 'partner_ref'.

alisha: i'm on it. pulling raw events now, will check utm and referrer stamping.

ben: could also be the post-click script we rolled yesterday. @alisha fyi the rollout note said we disabled sendRef for 10% of sessions.

mikaela: ahhh good call. that A/B was for cookie privacy toggle. did we forget to route those sessions into the legacy attribution pipeline?

alisha: preliminary logs: partner_ref sessions are landing with utm_campaign empty ~40% of the time. looking at proxy logs for the ad redirect.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/feature/sendRef-toggle -> 2026-03-22T12:02Z succeeded (canary 10%).

sam: if that's the case, the dashboard model (7-day lookback) will undercount conversions from partner_ref until the next attribution backfill.

ben: short term: recommend re-enabling sendRef for partner_ref traffic, and run a one-off backfill script to reassign events where possible.

mikaela: agreed. priority: fix incoming attribution, then backfill. alisha — can you confirm timeline?

alisha: i can revert the flag for partner_ref now and run a validation query. backfill will take ~2h for last 7 days.

mikaela: thanks. also let's add a note on the weekly KPI review deck about this — call it an attribution instrumentation incident not a performance regression.

sam: i'll add a slide and mark expected post-backfill delta.

ben: tagging #eng-infra to watch for DB pressure during backfill: cc @eng-infra.

alisha: revert done for partner_ref. running validation: 
```\nSELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE utm_campaign IS NOT NULL AND source='partner_ref' AND ts > now()-interval '7 days';\n```

alisha: validation shows utm_campaign restored for ~95% of new sessions. starting backfill now.

mikaela: awesome. keep updates here, and if the backfill changes weekly KPIs by >5% flag in the deck. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ops-bot: backfill-job-4321 started, estimated 2h.

sam: thx all. will queue a quick blurb for Friday KPI standup so PMs aren't surprised.

ben: once backfill completes, let's re-run the cohort conversion viz and snapshot into pulseboard for record.

mikaela: perfect. closing loop later today.
